subject: french

truths: “Je m'entends bien avec mon père” means “I get on well with my father”.
“Je suis fille unique” means “I am an only child (girl)”.

rounds.lie: “Passer un examen” means “to pass an exam”.
rounds.why: False friend — “passer un examen” means “to sit/take an exam”. “To pass” is “réussir un examen”.
rounds.truth: “Passer un examen” means “to sit/take an exam”.

rounds.why: “Fatigant” means “tiring”. “I am tired” is “je suis fatigué”.
truths: “Mener une vie saine” means “to lead a healthy life”.

rounds.why: “Le chômage” means “unemployment”. “A job” is “un emploi / un travail”.
truths: “Je voudrais être infirmier” means “I would like to be a nurse”.
“On peut compter sur lui” means “You can rely on him”.
The ending “gentille” describes a kind woman.
“Je me dispute avec ma sœur” means “I argue with my sister”.

rounds.lie: The ending “sportive” describes a sporty man.
rounds.why: “-ive” is the feminine ending, so it describes a woman. A sporty man is “sportif”.
rounds.truth: The ending “sportive” describes a sporty woman.
truths: “Il faut éviter les aliments gras” means “You must avoid fatty foods”.

rounds.lie: “Mes parents sont fiancés” means “My parents are married”.
rounds.truth: “Mes parents sont fiancés” means “My parents are engaged”.
truths: “Le bureau de tabac” means “the tobacconist's shop”.
